purpose: Explain a result as fitting someone’s ability or circumstances.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveな + だけあって
As you would expect of a chef, he handles a knife skillfully.
Her pronunciation is clear, as you would expect from daily practice.
As expected of a popular shop, there was a line before opening.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveな + だけあって
restrictions: Typically confirms an expectation based on a relevant fact.
mistake: Connect the praise to a concrete basis.
